_meta.description: Root configuration for the DCFG Company Brain. Agent: read this first.

agent_rules.path_format: All lowercase, kebab-case, no spaces, forward slashes only.
agent_rules.update_protocol: Read file, find entry by ID, update in place, write full file back.
agent_rules.never_delete: Set status to archived. Never remove entries.
agent_rules.attribution: Every entry must have created_by and last_modified_by.
agent_rules.cross_reference: Include dataverse_ref with entity_set and record_id when entry relates to a Dataverse record.
